title: WriteTestsRequest
description: What the test writer reads to write the slice's tests: the slice's conditions, the interface files' paths, the slice's worktree at its base, before any builder has worked in it, and the practices.

interface.description: The interface files the slice builds against, relative to the slice's worktree.

folder.description: The slice's worktree at its base commit, relative to the project, such as .forge/worktrees/TR2. No builder has worked in it yet.

practices.description: The practices files to read before writing, relative to the project, from forge's settings.
